items.text: In the legacy-ledger Python repository, Poetry is preferred, contrasting with the general preference for using uv in other Python projects.

attributes.preference: Preserve Poetry for legacy-ledger project; use uv for others.
attributes.replaces: Use uv for Python projects and ask before adding dependencies.
